== Card Text ==
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">戦闘運命数を引くのに必要な能力値が６以上になる。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">自分のタスケン・レイダーは没収値＋１。支配しているなら、フォース消耗に＋１。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
No lore is printed on this card.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Tatooine: Jundland Wastes.

'''Light Side:''' The ability required to draw battle destiny increases to 6 or more.

'''Dark Side:''' Your Tusken Raiders are forfeit +1. If you control, add 1 to the Force drain.
